description: An interface defining a visitor pattern for different types of FieldExpression instances in the Eclipse Ditto model query expression package.

classes.name: FieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: An interface for visiting various field expressions in a query, supporting operations like visiting attribute, feature, featureIdProperty, and simple field expressions.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visits an attribute field expression with the given key.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Visits a feature field expression with the given feature ID.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Visits a feature ID property expression with specified feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Visits a simple field expression with the given field name.
